offers.sn: We are looking for a Lead Optical Sensing Development Engineer to take technical ownership of the development and realization of our optical sensing solutions.
offers.rq: A Master’s degree or PhD in Optical Engineering, Applied Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field. Minimum 10 years of industrial experience in fiber-optic sensing, optical sensor development, photonics or precision optical systems Minimum 4 years of experience leading multi disciplined design teams.

offers.sn: As a Mechanical Development Engineer( Hydrophone Sensor) at Optics11, you contribute to the development and engineering realization of the hydrophone sensor subsystem throughout the product development lifecycle.
offers.rq: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, Precision Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Approximately 2–5 years of experience in precision mechanical design, instrumentation, sensor systems, or product development. Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

offers.sn: As a Marine Structures Development Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiBarrier marine structures subsystem.
offers.rq: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing offshore, marine, heavy mechanical, or structural systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

offers.sn: As a Subsea Cabling Development Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiBarrier cabling infrastructure subsystem.
offers.rq: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Photonics, Marine Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing complex fiber-optic, electro-mechanical, marine, or subsea systems. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

offers.sn: De specialisten en consultants van Valori helpen klanten met de kwaliteit van hun IT-systemen. In alle fasen van de software development lifecycle en zelfs daarna. Het resultaat is sneller naar productie met een betere kwaliteit.
offers.rq: Je hebt 3 jaar ervaring met minimaal 1 van de grote talen (TypeScript, JavaScript, Java,.Net of Python) Je hebt 2 jaar hands-on ervaring in het bouwen en/of onderhouden van een Test Automation Framework Je hebt 2 jaar hands-on ervaring met een front-end automation library (Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, Appium) Je beheerst Nederlands en Engels goed in woord en geschrift
